step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier with cross-coupled PMOS active loads and PMOS equalization switches. It operates in track mode (amplification) when VCLK2 is low, and latch mode (positive feedback) when VCLK2 is high.

paper_reference.title: A 40-GHz-Bandwidth, 4-Bit, Time-Interleaved A/D Converter Using Photoconductive Sampling

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the latch stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a 100uA tail current added for testing in SKY130 at 1.8V.

track_gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain in track mode

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_n / (gds_n + gds_p - gm_p + 2*geq). With Id=50uA per branch, gm_n~0.52mS, G_tot~310uS. Gain ~ 1.67 V/V = 4.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain is kept low to maximize bandwidth and ensure stability during track mode.
Limited by the intrinsic capacitances of the relatively large W=5u L=0.5u transistors in SKY130.

latch_delay.description: Time from clock rising edge to output latching to valid logic level

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant tau = Cout / G_latch ~ 40fF / 210uS ~ 190ps. Delay is typically 1-3 tau.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the initial differential voltage and the negative resistance provided by the cross-coupled PMOS.

input_capacitance.description: Equivalent input capacitance of the differential pair

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's description of a low-input capacitance flash converter.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring track mode gain, bandwidth, input capacitance, and latch mode delay.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Track-and-Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm0=5u L_xm0=0.5u

XM1 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOUT_MINUS VOUT_PLUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT_PLUS VIN_PLUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT_MINUS VIN_MINUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUT_MINUS VCLK2 VOUT_PLUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM0 VOUT_MINUS VBIASN VOUT_PLUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm0} w={W_xm0}

* Tail current source to bias the differential pair
I_tail N0 0 100u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIASN VBIASN 0 0.99

* Sources with DC, AC, and PWL for combined OP/AC/TRAN
* PWL keeps inputs balanced for OP/AC, then applies step for TRAN
VVIN_PLUS VIN_SRC 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PWL(0 0.9 0.9n 0.9 1n 0.95 5n 0.95)
R_in VIN_SRC VIN_PLUS 10k
VVIN_MINUS VIN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PWL(0 0.9 0.9n 0.9 1n 0.85 5n 0.85)
VVCLK2 VCLK2 0 DC 0 PWL(0 0 1.5n 0 1.52n 1.8 5n 1.8)

C1 VOUT_PLUS 0 10f
C2 VOUT_MINUS 0 10f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  let vout_cm = (v(VOUT_PLUS) + v(VOUT_MINUS))/2
  print vout_cm

  * 2. AC Analysis (Track mode)
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
  let vout_diff = v(VOUT_PLUS) - v(VOUT_MINUS)
  let gain_db = vdb(vout_diff)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1
  
  * Measure input capacitance via -3dB point of R_in and C_in
  meas ac vin_db_1M find vdb(VIN_PLUS) at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_in when vdb(VIN_PLUS)='vin_db_1M - 3' fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis (Latch mode)
  tran 10p 4n
  * Measure delay from clock rising to output latching high
  meas tran latch_delay trig v(VCLK2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(VOUT_MINUS) val=1.6 rise=1
  meas tran vout_min_final min v(VOUT_PLUS)
  meas tran vout_max_final max v(VOUT_MINUS)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
